description: The Toronto Maple Leafs drafted slick Whitehorse-born winger Gavin McKenna with the No. 1 pick on Friday night in Buffalo, N.Y.
title: Maple Leafs make forward Gavin McKenna first pick of NHL draft

description: The first Nova Scotian of African descent to be appointed to the province's judiciary, now retired, is joining the federal government's newly formed Advisory Council on Rights, Equality and Inclusion, after scathing criticism directed at Ottawa for its initial omission of a Black representative.
title: Ottawa adds retired judge Corrine Sparks to diversity council after pushback over membership

description: An appeals court on Friday upheld Harvey Weinstein's 2022 rape and sexual assault conviction in California, but ordered his trial judge to resentence him.
title: California appeals court upholds Weinstein's rape conviction, orders resentencing

description: British Columbia's attorney general announced an inquiry into online ticketing site StubHub, days after a CBC News investigation that revealed a mass failure by the ticket reseller platform and cancellation of thousands of FIFA World Cup tickets in Vancouver, Toronto and host cities across North America.
title: B.C. launches probe into StubHub over World Cup resale ticket fiasco

description: The Department of National Defence has reinstated two leaders of a respected Edmonton battalion days after announcing they had been removed pending an investigation.
title: Senior leaders of Edmonton-based infantry battalion reinstated after investigation

description: After four years of development, a new exhibit focused on displaced Palestinians has been unveiled at the Canadian Museum for Human Rights in Winnipeg.
title: Here's a look at the controversial Palestinian exhibit unveiled at Winnipeg's human rights museum

description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday blamed Iran for carrying out a drone strike on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz, calling it a "foolish violation" of the ceasefire agreement with the United States .
title: Trump blames Iran for attack on cargo ship in Strait of Hormuz

description: Vitali Stefanski has been found guilty of second-degree murder in the 2024 death of his ex-wife, Tatjana Stefanski.
title: Ex-husband found guilty of murdering Tatjana Stefanski in B.C. Interior

description: A Quebec facility that houses one of North America's only laboratories capable of developing film for professional productions is being shuttered, with the owner citing declining investment in local audiovisual productions as a factor.
title: Montreal film production lab to shut down, sparking calls from filmmakers for it to be saved

description: If your name is Janice and you feel personally victimized by Drake’s song Janice STFU, you're in luck — provided you can show government-issued ID. Rumour has it, the Toronto-born rapper is ready to make amends with all Janices by throwing them an exclusive Janices-only apology party.
title: Calling all Janices! Drake wants to apologize by throwing you a party

description: Daniel Senecal was arrested on Aug. 31, 2025, after police were called to a home in Welland, Ont., for a "medical assistance call involving a child." The 26-year-old pleaded guilty this week in St. Catharines court to multiple charges.
title: Registered sex offender in Ontario pleads guilty to sexual assault of 3-year-old in Welland, other charges

description: Sherritt International Corp. is shutting down operations at its refinery in Fort Saskatchewan, Alta., after running out of the feed inventory it receives from its Moa mine in Cuba.
title: Sherritt shutting down Alberta refinery as feed from Moa mine in Cuba runs out

description: Winnipeg police say they have had more than 100 "interactions" and made two dozen arrests since the service ramped up patrolling in areas of the city affected by open drug use and trafficking earlier this week.
title: 10-day crackdown targets open drug use but not about 'criminalizing addiction': Winnipeg police

description: Israeli forces dropped leaflets over the southern Lebanese town of Mansouri on Friday ordering residents to leave, Lebanese state media reported. It was the first such order issued since the latest ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah took effect.
title: Israel drops leaflets over south Lebanon town ordering residents to leave

description: All Boivin, considered the most wanted fugitive in Canada, has been arrested in Spain, according to Radio-Canada sources.
title: Canada's most wanted fugitive, a Quebecer, arrested in Spain

description: A pilot landed on a rural Manitoba highway Thursday night after issuing an alert to emergency officials.
title: Small plane makes emergency landing on highway in western Manitoba

description: John Bolton, national security adviser during Donald Trump's first presidential administration, pleaded guilty on Friday to illegally retaining classified information, sealing a deal with federal prosecutors.
title: John Bolton, former Trump adviser, pleads guilty to 1 count of illegally retaining classified info

description: Between 2001 and 2024, the FCAC says RBC failed to transfer credits from deactivated credit card accounts to customers' new ones. This resulted in incorrect monthly credit card statements.
title: RBC fined $4.25 million over incorrect credit card statements

description: Health authorities across Europe were on high alert on Friday as a killer heat wave progressed across the continent, prompting alcohol bans and festival cancellations in France and cracking road surfaces open in Germany.
title: Europe on high alert as killer heat spreads, prompting alcohol ban and Pride parade delay in France

description: Recently appointed Gov. Gen. Louise Arbour on Friday added 56 new Canadians to what is considered the country's highest civilian honour.
title: Christine Sinclair, Michael J. Fox promoted to Order of Canada's highest level

description: Alberta’s highest court has barred a former Edmonton physician from launching an appeal against court-ordered sanctions that prohibit him from practising medicine or implying he’s licensed to care for any patient in the province.
title: Former Alberta doctor again ordered to stop ‘cancer coaching’ as appeal bid rejected

description: Serena Williams will face an opponent less than half her age when she plays 20-year-old Maya Joint in the first round at Wimbledon for her first singles match in nearly four years.
title: Serena Williams draws 20-year-old Maya Joint in first Wimbledon singles match in 4 years

description: McKenna is projected to be the first overall selection at this year's draft, which happens on Friday. That means the 18-year-old could be headed to Toronto.
title: Maple Leafs or not, Yukon's Gavin McKenna set to make hockey history in NHL draft

description: A Saskatoon teacher who just turned 38 — the same age her mother died from leukemia — marked the milestone by running 1,500 kilometres in a month, crossing Saskatchewan north to south. She reached the finish line at the Canada-U.S. border Thursday.
title: Tears and champagne as Saskatoon runner finishes 1,500-km north-to-south run in memory of her mother

description: Russian air defences intercepted 660 Ukrainian drones in a major nighttime attack on 12 Russian regions as well as the Russia-held Crimean peninsula, the Black Sea and the Azov Sea, Russia's Defence Ministry said Friday.
title: Russia reports large-scale Ukrainian drone attack across 12 regions

title: We know violent and gory videos exist online. Teens are seeing more of them than you'd think

description: The federal government is expected to announce on Friday that it will prioritize infrastructure upgrades that allow provinces to share excess electricity more cheaply and easily.
title: Energy minister to name 5 priority power-line projects for federal backing today

description: Iran and Egypt's FIFA World Cup game on Friday is being marketed as the 'Pride Match' by Seattle organizers. It's not a decision made by FIFA, but that hasn't stopped a wave of controversy from clouding the buildup to the pivotal group-stage game.
title: Iran and Egypt will headline Seattle's 'Pride Match.' Here's why that's controversial

description: Written by first-time screenwriter Ana Nogueira and directed by action-newbie Craig Gillespie, it is frankly a shock how directionless this follow-up to the DCU's 2025 eclectically energetic Superman is.
title: Supergirl is almost impressively boring. Almost.

description: Marina Mabrey matched the WNBA scoring record with 53 points to help the Toronto Tempo rout the Los Angeles Sparks 125-97 on Thursday night in Toronto.
title: Marina Mabrey matches WNBA scoring record with 53 points to help Tempo rout Sparks
